gatoh.agents.agents.Agent.update

Agent.update(opinion_silenced: dict[str, bool], negation_ocurred: bool) → None[source]
Updates the internal state of the agent after the model has stepped:

  1. Updates what social hierarchies the Agent’s opinion is currently silenced in

  2. Inverts the Agent’s current opinion if opinion negation ocurred

Parameters:

  • opinion_silenced – A mapping of <hierarchy : flag> indicating which social hierarchies the Agent is silencing themselves in.

  • negation_ocurred (bool) – A flag indicating if opinion negation has ocurred in the current iteration.
